description: Runs an agent of an installed harness (see list_harnesses) on a task in cwd and returns its final message as JSON {session_id, text, stop_reason, usage, duration_s, warnings?}; with schema, structured replaces text. description names the thronglet for listings. With background: true the call returns {session_id, state, queued} as soon as the turn runs; collect the result with wait_thronglet.

agent.description: <harness>/<model>[:<effort>], e.g. claude/opus:max, codex/gpt-6-sol:xhigh; valid values: list_harnesses

background.description: Return as soon as the turn is running (or queued behind the session's current turn); collect the result with wait_thronglet

cwd.description: Absolute path; the agent works in this tree

description.description: What this thronglet is for, in a few words; shown in session listings

schema.description: JSON Schema (draft-07 or 2020-12) for structured output: the agent ends with a matching JSON value as its final message, returned as `structured` instead of `text`

timeout_s.description: Wall-clock limit for the run in seconds; default from config (21600)

name: run_thronglet
